# v2.1.0b3

## 2026-11-08

This beta improves authorization, camera cleanup and capture reliability.
It includes the features and fixes from the previous 2.1.0 betas.
The stable release remains **2.0.0**.

## Fixes

- Agent configuration changes require the existing maintenance credential.
  The regular API token cannot enable maintenance or replace its credential.
  Explicit bootstrap and recovery with the maintenance token remain supported.
- Home Call WebSocket commands require camera control permission. ICE messages
  are accepted only from the connection that owns the live subscription.
- Stopping video cancels pending WebRTC setup, blocks new offers until stopping
  completes and ignores late provider callbacks.
- Simultaneous captures and Wyoming analysis use separate artifacts. Capture
  automations receive the exact output paths; guarded unlock rejects captures
  belonging to a different device.
- Repeated agent discovery and integration unload no longer leave duplicate
  event renewal timers or registry listeners running.
- Cancelling a capture also stops and reaps its FFmpeg process.

## Update

1. In HACS, open the integration menu, choose **Redownload**, enable beta
   versions and select **2.1.0b3**.
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Complete the agent-update Repair to install the bundled **2.1.0b3** agent.
   The agent authorization fix requires this update.
4. Re-import the Ring Capture and Wyoming blueprints when using those workflows
   to adopt the per-capture response paths.

Existing beta display pages do not need reapplying solely for this update.
When upgrading from stable, apply the Display patch to use the new native pages;
applying it restarts the device GUI.

See [beta and update guidance](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b3/docs/advanced-maintenance.md#beta-versions).
Normal agent updates remain SSH-free. The device's legacy transport limitations
remain documented in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b3/SECURITY.md).
